exact_state_regime_rule: Baseline risk days remain unchanged. On baseline CASH days only, the probe enters full BTC risk when breadth ignition is ON, the volatility-hostility veto is not active, and the existing hard BTC risk-off invalidation is false; otherwise it remains CASH.
exact_universe_definition_used: Fixed liquid core universe from data/ohlcv only: ADA, AVAX, BNB, BTC, DOGE, DOT, ETH, LINK, LTC, SOL, TRX, XRP. An asset is daily eligible only after its own 120-day moving average is available; the breadth signal is valid only when at least 8 of the 12 fixed assets are eligible.
exact_breadth_formula_used: For each date, breadth = count(eligible assets with close > own 120-day SMA and own 20-day SMA > own 120-day SMA) / count(eligible assets).
exact_breadth_definition_used: For each date, breadth = count(eligible assets with close > own 120-day SMA and own 20-day SMA > own 120-day SMA) / count(eligible assets).
exact_volatility_measure_used: Slow BTC realized volatility is the 20-day rolling standard deviation of BTC daily returns annualized with sqrt(365), using min_periods=20.
exact_smoothing_rule_used: Smoothed breadth is a single causal 5-day EMA of the existing pure breadth ignition source ratio, using span=5, adjust=False, and min_periods=5.
exact_threshold_rule_used: Breadth ignition starts when the causal 5-day EMA crosses above the exact existing pure breadth ignition threshold of 2/3, and remains ON while that smoothed breadth stays above 2/3.
exact_volatility_threshold_rule_used: The raw volatility hostility condition is true when slow BTC realized volatility is greater than its own 63-day rolling median multiplied by 1.20, using min_periods=63.
exact_persistence_rule_used: The binary volatility-hostility veto activates only after 2 consecutive raw veto-true days and clears only after 2 consecutive raw veto-false days.

exact_why_materially_different.soft_gate_line: It does not soften a BTC entry gate or reuse prior early-entry gate logic; it keeps breadth ignition as the activation driver and adds a separate hostile-volatility veto.
exact_why_materially_different.persistence_line: It does not hold exposure because a prior constructive window existed; exposure requires current smoothed breadth ignition and can be blocked by the binary volatility veto.
exact_why_materially_different.pre_activation_line: It does not add an asset-specific high-conviction pre-activation sleeve; the activation source is fixed-universe breadth and the new dimension is BTC volatility hostility.
exact_why_materially_different.pilot_to_full_line: It has no Pilot state, no Pilot-to-Full ladder, and no partial-weight state machine; exposure is binary CASH versus full BTC risk on baseline CASH days.
exact_why_materially_different.l1_trend_filter_line: It does not estimate a one-sided BTC endpoint slope; breadth still comes from smoothed cross-sectional participation, while BTC volatility only acts as a veto.
exact_why_materially_different.pure_breadth_ignition_line: It is not pure breadth-only ignition because risk-on additionally requires the slow BTC realized-volatility hostility veto to be inactive.

cost_model.source_context: phase68i dynamic ladder export fee/slippage fields used only as secondary cost assumptions

stop_condition.rule: stop if DD protection kills earlier-activation benefit, or DD still worsens materially, or the volatility veto reintroduces churn/noisy switching, or net benefit disappears after costs

pause_condition.rule: pause if tradeoff improves materially versus pure breadth ignition but remains too narrow for stronger progression language
